title: Prescriptions Patient Safety Notice: Error Reports on a Controlled Short Fill
content:
Where the controlled short fill behind a declined owed balance on a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Schedule V Controlled Prescription, Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription or Schedule II Controlled Prescription class has been reported as a dispensing error, the controlled count amount applies.

## Notice

The controlled count amount looks at the dispensing-error reports that name the controlled short fill:

1. a report with the review outcome **confirmed** adds **1.00**;
2. a report still **pending review**, with none confirmed, adds **0.50**;
3. no such report adds nothing.

The amount is added to the controlled decline credit.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Confirmed reports naming the short fill | Reports pending review naming it | Amount added |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | any | 1.00 |
| none | 1 or more | 0.50 |
| none | none | nothing |

A report whose outcome is not confirmed, with no other report naming the short fill, adds nothing.
